Class EquinixMcpServer

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server.EquinixMcpServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class EquinixMcpServer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community server, not affiliated with Equinix and unrelated to Equinix's private-beta Fabric MCP server. It exposes this SDK's design engines and cross-domain reads as MCP tools over stdio only, executing under the operator's client-credentials. 
EquinixMcpServer server = EquinixMcpServer.builder()
        .credentials(accessKey, secretKey)     // or .session(existingEquinix)
        .toolsets(Toolset.DESIGN, Toolset.IBX) // optional; default: everything
        .build();                              // registers tools and starts serving stdio

The tool catalog is deliberately small (see catalog(Set)). The Safe Mutation Broker's dry-run-first mutation pair lives in the opt-in mutate toolset — served only when that toolset is explicitly selected, never by default. Custom extensions register through EquinixMcpServer.Builder.additionalTools(ToolRegistration...) using the exact same ToolRegistration seam the built-ins (broker included) use.

stdout is sacred: the MCP wire protocol owns it. This class and every handler log via slf4j only; EquinixMcpServerMain routes slf4j-simple to stderr.

    • catalog

      public static List<ToolRegistration> catalog(Set<Toolset> toolsets)
      The built-in read-only tool catalog for the selected toolsets. The Toolset.DESIGN and Toolset.FABRIC ids currently select the same seven engine tools (they are all Fabric-backed); portal, ne, and ibx add their domains' reach. The Toolset.MUTATE toolset is deliberately not part of this static catalog: the Safe Mutation Broker's tool pair shares a per-server proposal store, so EquinixMcpServer.Builder.build() registers it per instance when (and only when) mutate was explicitly selected.
      Parameters:
      toolsets - the selected toolsets
      Returns:
      the matching registrations, in catalog order
